title: Rachel
summary: Wife of Jacob, and mother of Joseph and Benjamin. Jones dates her death at Benjamin’s birth.
description: Wife of Jacob. This Appendix F row is her death. The same words also date Benjamin’s birth, which is a separate record. Leah, Bilhah, and Zilpah were not created.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament) prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (2265 1739 Rachel dies birthing Benjamin). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

death.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
death.note: This row dates Rachel’s death. The same words also date Benjamin’s birth, on benjamin.
